homepage.title: Do You Show Dementia Signs?
homepage.summary: Three rounds of memory slips, word mix-ups, and quick brain-teaser moments. See how your answers stack up.

footer.aboutText: This quiz mixes playful memory-style prompts, everyday thinking moments, word clues, and simple brain teasers. It is for general knowledge, entertainment, and self-reflection only. It is not a dementia screening tool, medical advice, diagnosis, cognitive assessment, or clinical test. If you are worried about memory, thinking, mood, communication, or daily functioning changes in yourself or someone else, speak with a qualified healthcare professional.

landing.quickStartText: Answer quick questions about memory slips, word mix-ups, daily thinking, and basic reasoning.

stageGroups.title: Memory Mischief
stageGroups.encouragement: Nice start. Your first round of memory moments is locked in.

questions.prompt: You open the fridge and instantly forget the mission. How often is that you?
choices: Rarely, or it pops back quickly
Sometimes when I am doing three things at once
Often enough that it annoys me
Very often, and it derails what I was doing

questions.prompt: A familiar task suddenly feels like it has too many steps. How often does that happen?
choices: Only with new or messy tasks
Sometimes with things I know well
Often with tasks that used to feel easy

questions.prompt: The word is right there... and then it vanishes. How often do common words escape you?
choices: Rarely, or they come back fast
Sometimes when I am tired or distracted
Often enough that talking feels harder
Very often, and I lose the whole sentence

questions.prompt: You walk into a room and stand there like a loading screen. How often?
choices: Rarely, or I remember after a second
Often enough to interrupt my day

questions.prompt: Someone says, “You already asked me that.” How often does that catch you by surprise?
choices: Often enough that people mention it
Very often in the same conversation

questions.prompt: You start making tea, coffee, or a snack and lose track of the next step. How often?
choices: Often enough that I avoid it

questions.prompt: Tiny recall game: remember this for later — River = 42. What word should you remember?
An appointment is important, but it still slips your mind. How often?
Mid-conversation, the plot disappears. How often do you lose the thread?
A normal chore suddenly feels like it needs an instruction manual. How often?
choices: Sometimes with chores I know well
Often enough that I need help

stageGroups.title: Everyday Brain Glitches
stageGroups.encouragement: Keep going. The last round adds tiny puzzles and delayed recall.

questions.prompt: You briefly wonder what day it is, where you are, or which way you came from. How often?
choices: Only for a moment, then I reset
Often enough that I need help

questions.prompt: Bills, recipes, forms, or simple plans start feeling weirdly harder. How often?
choices: Only when the task is new or stressful
Sometimes with tasks that used to feel easy
Often enough that I avoid them

questions.prompt: Your keys do a magic trick and appear somewhere odd. How often can you not retrace it?
choices: Sometimes, but I usually work it out
Often enough that it causes problems
Very often, and I cannot figure it out

questions.prompt: A familiar walk or drive suddenly feels less familiar. How often?
choices: Often enough that I avoid routes

questions.prompt: You make a money or shopping choice and later think, “Why did I do that?” How often?
choices: Very often and it causes problems

questions.prompt: Important things end up in places that make no sense. How often?
choices: Sometimes, but I find them by retracing steps
Often enough to disrupt my day
Very often and I cannot retrace it

questions.prompt: Your social battery disappears faster than usual. How often does that feel unlike you?
choices: Very often, and it feels unlike me

questions.prompt: A simple plan needs more help than it used to. How often?
choices: Only for new or complicated plans

questions.prompt: Left and right suddenly become a coin toss. How often?
choices: Very often in places I know

questions.prompt: People say your mood or personality seems different. How often does that happen?
choices: Often enough that I notice a pattern
Very often and it affects relationships

questions.prompt: Brain teaser: what comes next? 2, 4, 8, 16, ?
Direction check: you face north, then turn right. Which way are you facing?
Delayed recall: earlier, River was paired with which number?
Word snap: hot is to cold as up is to ___?
Calendar jump: if today is Tuesday, what day is it in three days?
Odd one out: apple, banana, carrot, orange.
Mini maze: walk forward, turn left, then turn left again. Compared with the start, you face...
Which sentence is easiest to follow?
choices: The keys are on the table.

questions.prompt: Tiny list: cup, moon, train. Which item was second?
Final common-sense check: if real memory or thinking changes are new, frequent, or affecting daily life, what is the sensible next step?
choices: Speak with a qualified healthcare professional
Use one quiz as a diagnosis
